answer: Your records don't list any allergies. The allergy list from the hospital records is empty, and none of your conditions, medicines or other entries mention a drug, food or other allergic reaction. That is not the same as proof that you have none. It may only mean none was ever recorded, so please tell your doctor or pharmacist about any reaction you remember. One related point: you had a CT scan with contrast dye in July 2025, and nothing in your records suggests a reaction to it.
